# Aadhil Anwar

> Security engineer at GoDaddy specializing in network security, vulnerability research, API exploitation, and cloud security on AWS. Reported high-severity vulnerabilities (CVSS 9.1, 8.8, 9.6) in production APIs and university systems. CompTIA Security+, Network+, CySA+ and PenTest+ certified. Top 3% on TryHackMe. Based in India.

Aadhil Anwar (full name Aadhil Anwar Sadath) is a security engineer working in network security at GoDaddy, focused on infrastructure security, access control architecture, and cloud security on AWS. He has reported critical vulnerabilities including broken access control in university APIs (CVSS 9.6), parameter tampering in payment systems, and high-severity API flaws (CVSS 9.1, 8.8) with working proof-of-concept exploits.

Previously interned in network engineering at Lovely Professional University (LPU), where he automated log analysis pipelines, identified network anomalies using Wireshark and Splunk, and refined VLAN segmentation and access controls. As Cybersecurity Lead at the Cisco CyberSec Symposium, he built vulnerable lab environments and trained 2000+ students in IDOR, SSRF, privilege escalation, and API security.

He holds five industry certifications, has placed top 5 in multiple national CTFs, and received a 1,00,000 INR startup grant for a privacy-focused blockchain feedback system.

Skills: Web & API Exploitation, Penetration Testing, Vulnerability Research, Bug Bounty & Responsible Disclosure, Network Security, SIEM & Log Analysis (Splunk, ELK), Threat Detection & Triage, Security Automation, VLAN/ACL Architecture, Packet Analysis, Cloud Security (AWS), Wireshark, Burp Suite, Nmap, Metasploit, Nessus, Python, Bash, Git.
